# ankra_ai_ticket_sync_connection (Resource)

An outbound AI ticket sync connection (`ankra tickets sync connections`) that mirrors the organisation's tickets to Jira, Linear or a generic webhook. The tracker credential is write-only (Terraform 1.11 or later): it is sent to the platform, stored in its secret store and never returned, so it never reaches plan or state; bump `credential_wo_version` to send a new one. Destroy deletes the connection and its stored credential. Needs an organisation admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Terraform 1.11 or later: the credential is write-only and never stored
# in state. Bump credential_wo_version to send a new one.
resource "ankra_ai_ticket_sync_connection" "linear" {
  name                  = "ops-board"
  provider_name         = "linear"
  config                = { team_key = "OPS" }
  credential_wo         = { api_key = var.linear_api_key }
  credential_wo_version = 1
  sync_min_priority     = "high"
}

variable "linear_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Connection name, unique in the organisation.
- `provider_name` (String) Tracker: `jira`, `linear` or `webhook`. Changing it replaces the connection.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `config` (Map of String) The tracker's non-secret settings, such as the Jira site and project or the Linear team. The platform keeps only the keys the tracker knows.
- `credential_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The tracker credential, such as an API token, as a write-only attribute. Required by trackers that need one.
- `credential_wo_version` (Number) Version of `credential_wo`. Changing it sends `credential_wo` again, which replaces the stored credential. Required with `credential_wo`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether tickets are mirrored.
- `sync_event_scope` (String) Which ticket events are mirrored.
- `sync_kinds` (Set of String) Ticket kinds mirrored.
- `sync_min_priority` (String) Lowest priority mirrored.

### Read-Only

- `credential_configured` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a credential for the connection.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the connection.
- `last_error` (String) The last sync error; null when the last sync succeeded.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by connection id. The credential is never read back.
terraform import ankra_ai_ticket_sync_connection.linear 6e2d3c4b-5f6a-4b7c-9d8e-0f1a2b3c4d5e
```
